provenance.note: Dev vignette for slice 0009. Never scored. The drafter had read the 17 confidently wrong findings from labels in the twelve scored conversations outside the least-seen three, and writes the agent's fixes too. Classes: self-correction L4 (its correction arrives in the reply to the clinical L5) and L14 (correction with no marker word); polarity L33 (an exclusion that holds); hedged or interpretive L34 (defer: whether an old reaction was to a similar compound). Controls: L20 and L21 (a man denying pregnancy and breastfeeding, does-not-hold by the scored vignettes' convention, not does-not-apply); L23 (names women and men, so it applies to him, and a firm agreement); L35 (a plain denial). L3 and L15 are clean answers on labels that failed in the twelve, written plainly, testing no class.
